tie_break: minimum score, then lexicographic canonical parameter JSON
candidate_sampling: independent uniform draws over each declared candidate list
aggregation: uniform arithmetic mean over all declared cases
component_sequence: LEA final error with both upstream components frozen
end_to_end: joint random search over initial, VT and LEA parameters for each named pipeline
budget_reason: 32 broad combinations and 16 local combinations are a fixed initial campaign budget; two deterministic boundary expansions. Pilot VT fits range from seconds upward; full sweeps are long-running offline jobs.
scope: Configurations are shared across all room families, rooms, noise conditions, layouts and A/B/AB subsets. Component-mode upstream configurations are also reused across pipeline partners. LEA and end-to-end configurations belong to a named initial/VT pipeline pairing.
